Yuto.text_desc: 17 year old Japanese teen male with dark messy black hair, anxious expression, slim build, white short-sleeve school uniform shirt with crest, navy slacks of 3-B class, casual home wear is loose dark hoodie and grey sweatpants. Smartphone-addicted, prone to online impulse buying. Lives at home with mother.

Ren.text_desc: 17 year old Japanese teen male hacker, dark hair half-covered with hoodie, sleepy droopy eyes, perpetually exhausted from late-night coding. Wears casual oversized black hoodie when not in school uniform. Has multi-monitor hacker den room.

Nei.text_desc: 16 year old Japanese teen girl with long platinum blonde hair, calm gentle perceptive expression, navy sailor blouse uniform with red ribbon tie and pleated navy skirt knee-length, white knee socks + black loafers.
